meta.name: devicetree
meta.description: Devicetree management for Zephyr RTOS. Covers syntax, bindings, overlays, Hardware Model v2 (HWMv2), and advanced node/property deletion patterns. Trigger when defining hardware topology, creating overlays, or mapping pins and peripherals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Zephyr RTOS 的设备树配置
copy.tagline_en: Manage Devicetree configuration for Zephyr RTOS
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to define hardware topology or peripherals with Zephyr RTOS

howto.what: Claude 能帮你创建和修改 Zephyr 项目的硬件描述文件（Devicetree），包括节点、属性、绑定和覆盖。还会验证配置并提供正确语法。
howto.when: 当你要求定义硬件拓扑、创建设备覆盖或分配引脚外设时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 I2C1 总线上添加一个温度传感器。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的 overlay 代码。

say.text: 检查我的 Devicetree 覆盖文件有没有错误。
say.note: Claude 会运行语法检查并反馈问题。

howto.what_en: Claude can create and modify Devicetree files for Zephyr projects, covering nodes, properties, bindings, overlays, and validation. It ensures correct syntax and hardware mapping.
howto.when_en: When you ask to define hardware topology, create overlays, or map pins/peripherals.

say_en.text: Add a temperature sensor on I2C1 bus.
Check my Devicetree overlay for errors.
say_en.note: Claude runs syntax check and reports issues.
